name: Kwesti
subtitle: Mindful moments, photo journal
oneLiner: Three small real-world side quests every Monday. Live one, snap a photo, keep it as a print. No streaks.
spotlightTitle: Kwesti gives you three small things every Monday.
description: Every Monday you get three small things to do out in the world. Swap one that doesn't fit, live it, and keep the photo as a print of your year.

feature.title: Kwesti gives you three small things every Monday.
feature.body: Each week you get three side quests to do out in the real world. Live one, take a photo, and keep it as a print. Miss a week and nothing breaks: there are no streaks.

rows.title: Watch water move for ten minutes
Walk barefoot on grass or sand

reviews.text: Kwesti doesn’t want your screen time, it wants your real time. It is the perfect antidote to notification fatigue and digital burnout.
reviews.author: VB_DC

reviews.title: More Living, Less Tracking
reviews.text: I absolutely love the philosophy behind this app. It reminds you that life isn’t about tracking every moment but actually living it.
reviews.author: pari0218

reviews.title: Beautiful app
reviews.text: A very nice app with simple and easy to understand interface which does not steal your data. It has helped me to pause, take a break and reconnect with life.
reviews.author: AntrikshP7

reviews.title: Great way of diverting your mind off
reviews.text: Kwesti has been great in taking some time off and giving the mind to relax and gather my thoughts in. An excellent concept to help get through the busy days.
reviews.author: Pirate king Kk
